claim: A fresh Rust graph can identify opaque factorized fixed-wing effectors, synthesize simultaneous six-axis programs without a Cartesian action lattice, keep those programs inside an offline specification-grounded structural envelope, condition their consequences on body-relative airflow and delayed power, and rebuild control after hidden complete authority loss.

plant.kind: auditable six-degree-of-freedom fixed-wing jet research plant

refusals: This is not CFD, flight qualification, or hardware safety evidence.
The structural facts are trusted design-analysis inputs; the experiment does not infer an ultimate limit by destructive exploration.
The simple plant does not replace finite-element load cases, material allowables, inspection, aeroelasticity, or certification evidence.
Python may copy raw physical receipts but may not select an effector or diagnose damage.
The direct reflex benchmark and multi-pass program synthesis latency must be reported separately.
